summary: Planned residential block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a stepped height envelope up to 100 ft; no design review approval or construction start found.

milestones.text: Completion expected: Block 4 is not named in any Phase 1-3 block list found (the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list is Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15); only the whole-project buildout target applies
milestones.basis_note: Whole-project buildout target: the October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment revised construction from six phases to three over the same 16 years, with the final Phase 3 'wrapping up construction in late 2035' per SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020); Block 4 has no dated or phase-specific schedule of its own in any source found. (Waterfront Park North/West are delivered 'with Block 4' per the Phase 1 application, but no calendar date attaches to that trigger either.)

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail and Non-Retail Sales/Services uses permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)

stepped envelope of 65 ft, 85 ft and 100 ft (max) across different portions of the block, per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3; the D4D's height-category text separately places Block 4 in a 'Lowrise buildings' category of up to 100 ft

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 4; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

The 2024 annual compliance report mentions 'Block 4' twice in the context of PG&E remediation of a 'Tank Farm Area and Block 4' -- it is not clear from that report whether this refers to the same Block 4 as this masterplan block or to a different PG&E-internal block numbering; not used as a source for this record's facts.
No phase-specific schedule found for Block 4; the added expected-completion milestone therefore uses only the whole-project buildout target (2035, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a block-specific date.
